text: Jesus wept.
This is the day which the LORD hath made.
Pray without ceasing.
Be still, and know that I am God.
He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son.
I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present.
But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength.
Lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world.
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace.
Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed.
Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness.
For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God.
And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind.
For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee.
Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
Blessed are the peacemakers.
The heavens declare the glory of God.
Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath.
To do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.
Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning.
